annotations.title: UN number to permitted UN packaging

description:
Find which UN-approved packagings may carry a dangerous liquid under ADR 2025 Table A and its packing instructions.
Use when: the user has a UN number from section 14 of a safety data sheet, or a substance name, and asks what it can travel in and how large. Instead: decode_un_packaging_mark to read a mark already on a container; adr_1000_points to test a vehicle load.
Inputs: send un or name; if both arrive, un wins. A name shorter than 3 characters is refused. Names match case-insensitively on proper shipping names and common names, and several matches return candidates, unless one entry is the everyday meaning (petrol: UN 1203, paint: UN 1263), which is used and noted in assumed.
Returns: one entry per Table A row for the number, each with class, packing group, limited quantity, mark level and, per container type, the permitted codes and the largest size in litres.
Behaviour: read-only; the same input gives the same answer. Covers 157 liquids; any other number returns ok:false with covered_un_numbers.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.
Each answer also carries publisher: the Fortitude21 containers made to the permitted codes, with links, and a quote_url.

name.description: Substance name instead of a UN number, e.g. "acetone" or "petrol". Matched against the proper shipping name and common names

un.description: UN number: four digits, with or without "UN", e.g. "1203" or "UN 1203". From section 14 of the safety data sheet

name: un_number_packaging

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

candidates.description: When ok is false for a name with several matches: the UN numbers to choose from

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

covered_un_numbers.description: When ok is false for an uncovered number: the 157 numbers covered

entries.description: One per ADR Table A entry: proper_shipping_name, class, packing_group, limited_quantity, packing_instructions, un_mark_level, containers (type, codes, allowed, largest_litres) and special_packing_provisions

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

source.description: The edition of ADR and the packing instructions used

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page
